seo.title: Skoura Palm Grove | Oasis near Ouarzazate | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Explore Skoura palm grove east of Ouarzazate: vast oasis, small kasbahs and quiet roads toward the Dadès.
seo.keywords: Skoura, Palmeraie de Skoura, Ouarzazate oasis

name: Palmeraie de Skoura
hero_subtitle: Vaste oasis de palmiers et kasbahs à l’est d’Ouarzazate — porte vers le Dadès.

overview.title: An oasis on the road of kasbahs
overview.p1: Skoura is a broad palm grove dotted with kasbahs. More rural than Ouarzazate town and often the first oasis stop toward the Dadès.
overview.p2: Pass through on a longer day or stay in a palm-grove lodge.

gallery.title: Palmeraie de Skoura
gallery.subtitle: Vaste oasis de palmiers et kasbahs à l’est d’Ouarzazate — porte vers le Dadès.

moods.title: Skoura through the day
moods.subtitle: Shade under palms and slow oasis roads.

1.title: Soft light in the palms
1.desc: Best walking and photography before peak heat.

2.title: Deep shade
2.desc: Stay under the canopy; open tracks are harsh at noon.

3.title: Warm ochre and green
3.desc: Beautiful contrast as sun lowers on kasbah walls.

food.title: Eat in Skoura
food.p1: Lodge restaurants and a few local eateries. Fewer options than Ouarzazate.
food.p2: About the oasis landscape; dining is simple.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: About 40–50 minutes east toward the Dadès.

2.title: Transport
2.desc: Private driver is easiest for viewpoints.

3.title: Continue onward
3.desc: Natural link to Dadès Gorge if you have more days.

q1.question: Day trip from Ouarzazate?
q1.answer: Yes — half-day or part of an eastbound route.

q3.question: Main things to see?
q3.answer: Palm groves, kasbahs and oasis life.

q5.question: Combine with Dadès?
q5.answer: Yes — logical stop on the way.
